parsed.name: Pfeiffer TPG 261 真空计
parsed.description: 用于测量和读取真空系统中的压力值，适合实验腔体、真空管路或泵组的真空状态监测。
parsed.description_en: Used to measure and read pressure in vacuum systems, suitable for vacuum state monitoring of chambers, vacuum lines, or pumping setups.

actions.description: 连接到真空计的通信接口。
actions.description_en: Connect to the vacuum gauge communication interface.

actions.description: 断开与真空计的通信连接。
actions.description_en: Disconnect communication with the vacuum gauge.

actions.description: 接收真空压力读数的原始字节数据。
actions.description_en: Receive the raw byte data of the vacuum pressure reading.
